test_sphere_collision: test the SphereCollisionTest class to verify sphere-plane, sphere-sphere, and sphere-capsule collision detection
test_ellipsoid_collision: test the EllipsoidCollisionTest class to verify ellipsoid-plane, ellipsoid-ellipsoid, ellipsoid-sphere, ellipsoid-capsule, and ellipsoid-cylinder collisions
test_capsule_collision: test the CapsuleCollisionTest class to verify capsule-plane, capsule-capsule, capsule-box face, edge, and deep penetration collision scenarios
test_convex_collision: test the ConvexTest class to verify box-plane, box-box, and convex-convex collision detection via SAT Gauss map
test_hfield_collision: test the HFieldTest class to verify sphere, capsule, and box collisions with heightfield terrain
test_body_pair_filter: test the BodyPairFilterTest class to verify self-collision and parent-child collision filtering with optional disable flags
test_top_k_contacts: test the TopKContactTest class to verify contact culling with max_contact_points and max_geom_pairs limits
test_collision_driver_dim: test the collision_driver.make_condim function to compute constraint dimensions for contact pairs
